purpose: Source pins and destination mapping for the bounded EffectCraft-to-Poet motion-authoring assessment.

effectcraft_sources.source_observation: Serializes per-side interpolation and per-dimension ease parameters; derives left/right icon-half semantics; includes temporal interpolation math in the same crate module.
effectcraft_sources.destination: Poet native timeline/property inspector intent and view model; evaluate via existing qualified Poet/Qualia owner.
effectcraft_sources.disposition: Semantics reference only; no code copied. Do not transplant ease_progress as an alternate interpolation solver.

effectcraft_sources.source_observation: EffectCraft-specific tagged value model includes scalar/vector/color/bool/enum/path/text/layer/gradient/string, coercion and interpolation behavior.
effectcraft_sources.disposition: Reference only; do not copy type or lerp behavior without a separate typed-value/colour/geometry mapping.

effectcraft_sources.source_observation: EffectCraft media-time base, saturating conversions/arithmetic, half-open ranges, rational frame rates and snapping.
effectcraft_sources.destination: Poet/Qualia admitted time authority and native timeline adapter.
effectcraft_sources.disposition: Not copied. Keyframe.time is this EffectCraft Tick, so current keyframe serialization and evaluation are not independent of this crate.
